description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Number of Tokens" and an unlabeled metric for four different data categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and utilizes a linear scale with numeric tick marks spaced at an interval of 200, displaying values from 200 to 800, while the plotted data points span from approximately 100 to 1000. The y-axis lacks a title and units, featuring a linear scale with numeric tick marks at an interval of 10, ranging from 10 to 40. The "Tutorials" category is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, displaying a continuous upward trend from a starting value of approximately 23 at x=100 to an ending value of roughly 44 at x=1000. The "Library Documentation" category is depicted by a solid red line with circular markers, which rises from about 26 at x=100 to a peak of approximately 43 at x=700, before declining slightly to end at roughly 42 at x=1000. The "StackOverflow posts" category is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it initially increases from approximately 33 at x=100 to a peak of 36 at x=400, followed by a steady decline to an ending value of about 26 at x=1000. Finally, the "Github files" category is represented by a solid green line with circular markers, showing a consistent increase from a starting value of roughly 28 at x=100 to a final value of approximately 45 at x=1000.
